question: Should OpenClaw accept Android Chat tab re-entry skipping same-session history refresh when live healthy history is already applied?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix, but it changes session-state refresh behavior in a maintainer-labeled Android path, so automation should not decide the product/runtime tradeoff alone.

options.title: Accept the narrow gate
options.body: Land after exact-head Android checks pass, accepting that healthy same-session tab entry relies on the applied live-history marker instead of fetching again.

options.title: Require refresh on tab entry
options.body: Ask for a different UI-only loading suppression if maintainers want tab re-entry to keep fetching history every time.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow gate
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head Android checks pass, accepting that healthy same-session tab entry relies on the applied live-history marker instead of fetching again.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on ChatController reconnect/session-state and model-selection paths makes this the best available owner for the session-refresh tradeoff.
